Full job description
**Federal Project - Applicant must be a United States Citizen with Active Secret Clearance**

Baer is looking for SAP S4 Test Developer for a 4+ month Federal remote project.

Title: SAP S4 Test Developer
Location: Remote (Must be based in US)
Duration: 4 months
Rate: All-inclusive
Alignment: W2 or C2C

Overview

The SAP S/4HANA Test Developer will design, develop, maintain, and execute test assets for a DoW SAP S/4HANA implementation within an Agile SAFe environment. The role will support functional, technical, integration, security, Fiori, regression, UAT, negative, exploratory, and end-to-end testing across SAP business processes and integrated systems.

Description:
Develop test scenarios, test cases, scripts, procedures, and test data from requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
Execute functional, integration, regression, security, Fiori, UAT, and end-to-end tests.
Maintain requirements traceability and test coverage through the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
Document test results, evidence, defects, and corrective actions.
Analyze failed tests, participate in defect triage, and perform retesting and regression testing.
Support data conversion, interfaces, integrations, and end-to-end business process testing.
Collaborate with government stakeholders, system integrators, functional/technical SMEs, interface teams, security teams, and the Government UAT Lead.
Support UAT planning, execution, entrance/exit criteria, test reporting, and production-readiness assessments.
Ensure test deliverables and evidence meet project quality and release-readiness standards.

Requirement:
Experience testing SAP S/4HANA implementations.
Strong experience developing and executing SAP test scenarios, test cases, scripts, and test data.
Experience with functional, integration, regression, UAT, security, Fiori, and end-to-end testing.
Experience with defect management, test traceability, test evidence, and reporting.
Knowledge of SAP business processes, configurations, interfaces, and data conversions.
Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Active DoD Secret clearance required.

Company Overview:

Baer provides best-in-class engagement experiences for our consultants. Our job requirements are carefully vetted and are typically associated with pivotal programs offering tremendous opportunities to expand your skills leveraging the latest solutions.

Baer is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran.
